context: Daichi and Mei plan an island trip by ferry.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: travel planning; transport vocabulary (島/州/交通/料金/増加) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 南の島、行ってみたいなあ。
lines.en: I'd love to visit a southern island.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 交通は、船が安いんですよね?
lines.en: For transport, ferries are cheap, right?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そや、船の料金は手頃やで。
lines.en: Right, the ferry fare is reasonable.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夏は、観光客が増加しますよね。
lines.style: thoughtful woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 増加する前に、予約しとこか。
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: その島は、どの州にあるんですか?
lines.en: Which province is that island in?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 南の州や。料金も州ごとに違うで。
lines.en: The southern province. Fares differ by province too.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm informative delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 交通の手配、私がしておきますね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm reliable closing delivery throughout
